messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-30] standup/cinder/2025-01-30: If the catalog service is down, the search indexer is down: it relies on it for product documents.
- [2026-04-01] handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer: From today the pager for the search indexer rings the Boreal team, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-04-22] standup/cinder/2025-04-22: The search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11; the pin lifts when the full reindex completes.
- [2025-12-18] standup/atlas/2025-12-18: Decided in today's standup: search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, since incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.
- [2025-05-20] handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer: Team Atlas is taking over search-indexer from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-06-09] standup/dune/2026-06-09: Observation from team Dune: after the retention change, search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2025-04-14] standup/cinder/2025-04-14: The catalog service calls the resizer for thumbnails, so treat the resizer as a hard dependency of the catalog service.
- [2026-05-27] standup/atlas/2026-05-27: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. The Atlas team noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. The catalog still relies on the resizer; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: For the record, the indexer is owned by Cinder.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2: Team Boreal noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-05-30] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Review of INC-2025-011 (Ledger, 2025-05-24). The root cause was an index missing after the schema migration. We decided that ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2025-02-07] standup/ember/2025-02-07: Dependency map update: scheduler needs the feature flag service (per-job kill switches).
- [2025-10-07] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Incident review INC-2025-023. The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03. Root cause: a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. Decision: reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: The reporting service is a the Dune team service.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-03-26] standup/dune/2025-03-26: Reminder that the reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. Observation from team Dune: after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-01-21] standup/dune/2025-01-21: Dependency map update: reporting needs the ledger service (the nightly balance export).
- [2026-06-04] standup/boreal/2026-06-04: Boreal noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-03-17] standup/cinder/2025-03-17: The catalog service can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2025-12-31] standup/atlas/2025-12-31: Atlas saw that the feature flag service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-03-20] standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2: Observation from the Boreal team: after the retention change, the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent. The Boreal team runs its planning on Thursdays.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-3: Heads-up from the Dune team: the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.
- [2025-04-29] standup/ember/2025-04-29: The scheduler still relies on the feature flag service; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-12-01] standup/boreal/2025-12-01: Heads-up from Boreal: the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.
- [2025-03-04] standup/atlas/2025-03-04: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.

Question: Which service depends on search-indexer?

The question: Which service depends on search-indexer? That would be a service X where X relies on search-indexer.

- reporting needs the ledger service (nightly balance export) — reporting depends on ledger.

- search indexer relies on catalog for product documents.

I don't see any service that depends on search-indexer. The memory says search-indexer depends on the catalog service, not the other way.

So the answer: I don't know.
